verdict.rationale: GDScript is documented as Godot's purpose-built, gradually typed, object-oriented language. It drives the engine's API, and even editor plugins and editor scripts can be written entirely in GDScript. Community comments confirm it is the first-class language, ahead of C#. Productivity evidence is mixed: one developer calls it awkward (no list comprehensions, tuples or first-class functions) and an older comment calls it poorly documented. Nothing in the pack documents a debugger; only a built-in language server is evidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of a debugger (breakpoints, stepping, inspection), explicit documentation that GDScript exposes the full engine API, and independent corroboration of productivity.
